title: troubles with rust / cargo / blake3 on Haiku
body:
I am trying to add blake3 and it has some rust dependencies.

I could get all platforms working, except Haiku, see there:
- https://github.com/borgbackup/borg/pull/9643
- CI: https://github.com/borgbackup/borg/actions/runs/25876342869/job/76044614227?pr=9643

It seems it can't find `cargo`. Shouldn't that be in `rust_bin` package?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: @participant3 @participant4 can you help, please?

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
The command for cargo should be fine (from the CI failure): 
```
~> cargo --version
cargo 1.94.1 (29ea6fb6a 2026-03-24)
```
Adding blake3 to the recipe here doesn't seem to have any effect, or failure not finding cargo (didn't add that to the recipe yet). How do I make sure it will be used during the build?

EDIT: does this use the blake3 rust crate? Because at this moment our blake3 package doesn't provide that (nor python module?).

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
blake3 (package from pypi.org) is required by borgbackup's pyproject.toml, so it will be pulled and installed by that.

For the more popular platforms, that will fetch a binary wheel from pypi (no rust tools needed), but for the BSDs, omniOS and Haiku, there is no binary wheel, so it will build from source and need rust and build tools.

I only put that separate pip install command there to maybe get a more clear / better visible error output from a blake3-only install / build.

CI config: https://github.com/borgbackup/borg/pull/9643/changes#diff-b803fcb7f17ed9235f1e5cb1fcd2f5d3b2838429d4368ae4c57ce4436577f03f

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Far from being a guru of anything here but...

From the CI logs I can see linked here, there's not much I can say, "from the python side". As @reporter mentions, the line `cargo --version` doesn't seems to be working, ssh ends, and we don't even get to the `pip install` part.

Maybe the Haiku version on the CI VM is too old for the rust_bin/cargo package? Not sure how feasible is to update the image (will require an OS reboot to for changes in haiku*.hpkg packages to kick in).

Other than that.... I would try to get more detailed info about why `cargo --version` doesn't prints anything: maybe cat/tail/or copy the `/var/log/syslog` from the VM, it might contain crash/runtime_loader info or error messages.

----

@participant1 from *your* `borgbackup_blake3.txt`: both `zerotrie` and `icu_collections` fail to compile, I think from the same issue:

`fatal runtime error: out of TLS keys, aborting`.

That thing in particular might have been fixed in [hrev59718](https://github.com/haiku/haiku/commit/36aa36d060acd89b0dea8cfcf4c808925bd390c4).

----

Side note/light-nitpick: The name of the OS is just "Haiku" :-)

comments.body:

On the cargo version, even with the "older" one that should just work?
On the TLS thing, I've seen it mentioned in the ML, would have to switch from beta5 to nightly to check that out.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: @reporter: a heads up... in the [linked CI change](https://github.com/borgbackup/borg/pull/9643/changes#diff-b803fcb7f17ed9235f1e5cb1fcd2f5d3b2838429d4368ae4c57ce4436577f03f), you're doing `pkgman install -y rust_bin setuptools_rust`. That won't do what you intend, as that `setuptools_rust` is just an empty base package, and not the one you probably want... `pkgman install -y setuptools_rust_python310` (this is a [quirk/bug/mis-feature](https://github.com/haikuports/haikuporter/issues/192) from HaikuPorter).

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Update: switched to nighly to check: `pip3 install --user blake3` works, building and packaging `borgbackup` with `haikuporter` also worked, added almost 1MiB to the package, so something must be added (although I still don't see any blake3 mention in the package files). :)

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
Glad to hear that it works on nightly, it's just that this won't help our CI, which is based on cross-platform-actions project and only offers that (meanwhile rather old) Haiku beta.

I was assuming that setuptools_rust pulls the setuptools_rust_python310 as a dependency. But I don't know whether it even matters, adding that was just a random attempt in trying to get things working.

I'll try to get more logs...

About blake3 being mentioned in "package files" (which package files?) - this is only a pull request yet and it is mentioned in pyproject.toml in that PR. master branch ("borg2") does not yet use blake3 and 1.4-maint branch won't get blake3.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Issues with this Haiku VM (from cross-platform-actions) and cargo (due to outdated openssl in base beta5 installs), and with install seemingly getting stuck look similar to https://github.com/cross-platform-actions/action/issues/118 and https://github.com/cross-platform-actions/action/issues/116.

But both issues are already closed, so... not sure what to say, other than request `cross-platform-actions` to provide an already updated base beta5 image, or having to wait for Haiku to release beta6 (there are not set dates in Haiku-land, things are pretty much done "when ready", mostly due to the small team size).

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Did you try running "pkgman update -y" as mentioned in the issues @participant2 linked? Sometimes it happens that pkgman chokes, mostly it's enough to just kill the process with "Ctrl-c" (already downloads will be reused so not restarted when completed), then run the update again.
